scope: Bounded ordered original-based replay and selection of saved external effects in verified mixed histories

validation.nativeSuites: Not rerun; no Rust/DSP/driver changes. Prior native suite results remain baselines.
validation.precedingCI: Both 0.13.66 general CI and iOS passed.

semantics.processors: External AU/VST3 effects; normalize, silence, DC removal, edge fades, invert, stereo swap/mono/copy. Unknown settings/types, chains/filters/restoration, unverified and retimed histories are refused before rendering.
semantics.admission: Verified journal v1, matched decoded 44100/48000 Hz mono/stereo, <=8 operations, first window <=30 seconds and 256 MiB PCM allocation estimate. Single-effect limits remain unchanged.
semantics.processing: Start from the entire first retained original window, execute each operation with its own local mask, crop preceding output only between saved windows, restore each plug-in base, never reuse transient helper state or earlier preview PCM.
semantics.publication: Replace only the selected recipe/mask. Persist the final window once through protect-before-publication; preserve original mapping, visible offset, siblings, other operations and one Undo/Redo.
semantics.ui: Choose a saved external effect in a compact dropdown. Waveform/Original/Preview show the final all-channel result; mask controls use the selected effect clock and map the current clip into it. Ranges outside the final window are explained in Info.
semantics.epoch: Root epoch state/ref stays latched across effect switches, including same-batch project round trips. Close and stale jobs cannot start later helpers or publish partial replay.
semantics.transport: Existing arrangement close/join still precedes source helper allocation and audition; monitor gain remains outside Apply.

phases: 48-kHz stereo mixed run passed with final production replay/epoch logic before the manifest-only 0.13.67 version bump. The later fixture decoder-context channel argument does not change its stereo behavior.
44.1-kHz mono mixed and 48-kHz stereo single-effect runs use the final version and fixture. Final focused/full suite, build and lint follow all production changes.
Initial mixed browser probe failed because its fixture did not expand Parameters in the ordinary effect panel; corrected fixture, no passed evidence claimed for that attempt.

Early lint/type checks caught shared epoch ref rendering and typed-array inference issues; fixed with root reactive epoch state plus event/effect ref checks and explicit PCM types. All final checks pass.
limitations: Every browser AudioContext is an offline substitute; no actual device, microphone, TCC, Wry output/listening or signed/mobile qualification.
FS/conversion/relocation IPC wrappers are synthetic; trusted Apple AUPeakLimiter/Steinberg ADelay DSP and fixture files are real. Parent tripwires do not establish arbitrary child plug-in sandboxing.
Actual mixed fixtures use four operations, a one-second first window and a half-second final window. The maximum admitted count/window is not a long-session responsiveness or memory benchmark.
Utilities are synchronous within each bounded stage and yield between stages. PCM estimates exclude arbitrary plug-in internals.

No legacy provenance promotion, chain/restoration replay, utility-parameter editor, larger window/count, Native recall/new-format admission, ordinary preview staging rewrite, install, signing, tag or Apple upload.
